cover_letter_text:
Please accept my application for the Graduate Civil Engineer role at Portal Contractors. Working on your earthworks and bulk excavation sites under the Project Manager, learning set-out, inspections and subcontractor coordination, is the kind of hands-on start I want.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked work against project requirements and carried out site inspections and safety checks. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I assisted with quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site reports and progress reports.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019).

I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own reliable transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I have not run set-out with survey instruments on a job yet, so I would be learning that from your site team.

I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
